teaser.en: Its runners stitch the sand dunes together, and each leaf is split at the tip like the print of a goat's hoof.
teaser.sw: Matawi yake yanayotambaa huyashona matuta ya mchanga pamoja, na kila jani limegawanyika kwenye ncha kama alama ya kwato ya mbuzi.

summary.en: Beach morning glory is a fleshy creeping vine of the upper beach, with pink-purple trumpet flowers and two-lobed leaves. Its long runners bind the loose sand of the dunes at Diani, Tiwi and Funzi.
summary.sw: Mlakasa ni mtambaa wenye unyama wa sehemu ya juu ya ufuo, wenye maua ya waridi-zambarau yenye umbo la tarumbeta na majani yenye ndewe mbili. Matawi yake marefu yanayotambaa hushikilia mchanga mlegevu wa matuta huko Diani, Tiwi na Funzi.

about.en:
Beach morning glory is a creeping vine that sends long runners across the sand, rooting as it goes. Its leaves are thick and fleshy, and split at the tip into two rounded lobes, like the cloven print of a goat's hoof, which gives it the English name goat's-foot creeper.

The flowers are wide pink to purple trumpets with a darker centre, opening in the morning and closing later in the day, like other morning glories. The seeds are carried in round capsules.
about.sw:
Mlakasa ni mtambaa unaotuma matawi marefu juu ya mchanga, ukitia mizizi unapoendelea. Majani yake ni manene na manono, na yamegawanyika kwenye ncha kuwa ndewe mbili za mviringo, kama alama ya kwato ya mbuzi iliyopasuka, na hiyo ndiyo inayoupa jina la Kiingereza *goat's-foot creeper*.

Maua ni tarumbeta pana za waridi hadi zambarau zenye kitovu cheusi zaidi, huchanua asubuhi na kufunga baadaye mchana, kama mimea mingine ya jamii yake. Mbegu hubebwa ndani ya vibuyu vya mviringo.

where.en: It grows on the upper beach and the fore-dunes along the whole coast, including Diani, Tiwi and Funzi. Look for it on the strip just above the high-tide line, where it spreads in a green net over the sand. It flowers for much of the year.
where.sw: Huota sehemu ya juu ya ufuo na kwenye matuta ya mbele ya mchanga kando ya pwani nzima, ikiwemo Diani, Tiwi na Funzi. Utaupata kwenye ukanda ulio juu kidogo ya mstari wa maji makuu, ambapo hutanda kama wavu wa kijani juu ya mchanga. Huchanua maua kwa sehemu kubwa ya mwaka.

uses.en:
Its runners bind loose sand, so it helps to hold the dunes together against wind and waves.

It is used in traditional medicine around the Indian Ocean.
uses.sw:
Matawi yake yanayotambaa hushikilia mchanga mlegevu, hivyo husaidia kuyashikilia matuta pamoja dhidi ya upepo na mawimbi.

Hutumika katika tiba za jadi kuzunguka Bahari ya Hindi.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili it is *majani ya mwaka* or *mlakasa*. In English it is beach morning glory or goat's-foot creeper, and its scientific name, *Ipomoea pes-caprae*, means 'goat's foot'.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *majani ya mwaka* au *mlakasa*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *beach morning glory* au *goat's-foot creeper*, na jina lake la kisayansi, *Ipomoea pes-caprae*, lina maana ya 'mguu wa mbuzi'.

conservation.en: It is widespread, but beachfront development is clearing it from parts of the coast.
conservation.sw: Umeenea sana, lakini ujenzi wa majengo kando ya ufuo unauondoa katika sehemu za pwani.

reason.en: Same genus: sweet potato is its close cousin
reason.sw: Jenasi moja: kiazi kitamu ni binamu yake wa karibu
Nacho pia hushikilia matuta ya mbele ya mchanga

reason.en: Grows along the same sandy beaches
reason.sw: Huota kando ya fukwe zilezile za mchanga
